problem_statement: Litestar does not officially support Python 3.14. Users attempting to run Litestar on Python 3.14 encounter compatibility issues with enum classes that inherit from both str and Enum, type annotation errors, and deprecation warnings from updated dependencies. The codebase uses the older pattern of 'class MyEnum(str, Enum)' which behaves differently in Python 3.14 compared to the newer StrEnum.
problem_statement_variant: Running Litestar on Python 3.14 throws TypeError in litestar/enums.py when using HttpMethod.GET in string comparisons. The error occurs because 'class HttpMethod(str, Enum)' pattern is deprecated in 3.14. Similar issues appear in litestar/dto/field.py with the Mark enum and litestar/openapi/spec/enums.py with OpenAPIFormat and OpenAPIType.
hints: Look at enum definitions in litestar/enums.py, litestar/dto/field.py, and litestar/openapi/spec/enums.py. The pattern 'class Foo(str, Enum)' should be migrated to 'class Foo(StrEnum)'. Also check pyproject.toml for dependency version constraints.
docker_file:
FROM python:3.11-slim
 

 WORKDIR /app
 

 ENV PIP_RESOLVER_BACKTRACKING_LIMIT=100
 ENV PYTHONPATH=/app
 

 SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
 

 RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential ca-certificates git libffi-dev libssl-dev libpq-dev python3-dev curl jq ripgrep wget && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
 

 RUN check_min() { tool=$1 ; min=$2 ; actual=$3 ; ok=$(awk "BEGIN{ split(\"$actual\",a,\".\") ; split(\"$min\",m,\".\") ; for(i=1 ; i<=3 ; i++){ if(a[i]+0>m[i]+0){print 1 ; exit} if(a[i]+0<m[i]+0){print 0 ; exit} } ; print 1}") ; if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ] ; then echo "FAIL: $tool $actual < minimum $min" >&2 ; exit 1 ; fi ; echo "OK: $tool $actual >= $min" ; } ; check_min git 2.25.0 "$(git --version | awk '{print $3}')" && check_min curl 7.70.0 "$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' curl | sed 's/[+-].*//')" && check_min wget 1.20.0 "$(wget -q --version | head -1 | awk '{print $3}')" && check_min jq 1.6 "$(jq --version | sed 's/^jq-//')" && check_min rg 13.0.0 "$(rg --version | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')"
 

 COPY . .
 

 RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -e ".[full]" && pip install --no-cache-dir trio beanie beautifulsoup4 fsspec greenlet hypothesis python-dotenv starlette aiosqlite "asyncpg>=0.29.0" "psycopg[pool,binary]>=3.1.10,<3.2" psycopg2-binary "psutil>=5.9.8" "hypercorn>=0.16.0" "daphne>=4.0.0" opentelemetry-sdk httpx-sse "time-machine>=2.10.0" structlog aiohttp && pip install --no-cache-dir "pytest==8.3.4" pytest-asyncio pytest-mock pytest-xdist pytest-lazy-fixtures pytest-rerunfailures pytest-timeout covdefaults pytest-cov
 

 CMD ["sh", "-c", "pytest tests/unit/test_dto tests/unit/test_openapi tests/unit/test_signature tests/unit/test_datastructures -x -q"]
run_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
 set -euo pipefail
 

 SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
 REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
 cd "$REPO_ROOT"
 

 die() { echo "Error: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
 info() { echo "$*" >&2; }
 

 if [[ $# -eq 0 || -z "${1:-}" ]]; then
  info "=== Full test suite ==="
  pytest tests/unit/test_dto tests/unit/test_openapi tests/unit/test_signature -x -q
 else
  IFS=',' read -ra TEST_FILES <<< "$1"
  info "=== Targeted tests: ${TEST_FILES[*]} ==="
  pytest "${TEST_FILES[@]}" -x -q
 fi
